title: A Primer of the Struck Tone
summary: A first course in humming one steady note through the body so that the student learns to shake the air before any blow is tried.

title: The Sound Cultivator's Drill-Book
summary: A drill-book for the first season of sound work that trains the rattling fist and the counted pulse in a fixed order of practice.

title: Handbook of the Shaken Air
summary: A handbook on setting the air trembling around the hands and body so that a student learns to shake before they strike.

title: A Beginner's Course in Resonance
summary: A short course in finding the note at which a thing rings back and in using that ring for a first strike and a first guard.

title: The Listening Cultivator's Workbook
summary: A workbook that teaches the ear to read what the air carries and then turns that hearing into simple strikes and screens.

title: Primer of the Humming Bone
summary: A primer that sets the bones themselves humming so that a blow carries into the target and a hard knock is carried away.

title: Handbook of Pitch and Pulse
summary: A handbook of high and low pitch and of the body's own pulse as the two things a young sound cultivator learns to hold steady.

title: The Steady Vibration Drill-Book
summary: A drill-book of long even vibration that steadies the hands and calms a hurt body before it teaches any sharper stroke.
